Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

When your melee attack drops a creature to 0 HP, use a Reaction to move up to 3 squares without provoking and make a free Basic Melee attack against a different creature.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Time
One hour per crafting attempt.
Target / range / shape
One known Lesser Healing Bottle or Travel Food recipe.
Equipment / acquisition
A mixing kit (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed; both named recipes.
Type
Skill / Crafting / Utility

Learn Lesser Healing Bottle and Travel Food.

Brew: With its recipe's tools and materials, make or refill one Lesser Healing Bottle supply to d4 in one hour, without a roll.

Provisions: Craft Travel Food using its full one-hour interval and materials. Make a Knowledge crafting roll for 1/2/3 inventory steps on Weak/Standard/Strong, up to d8.
